name: Jishua
title: Head of a Levitical family
summary: Jishua (also spelled Jeshua) was a Levite who played a role in Israel's return from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in connection with Levitical families that served in the temple and participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem and the temple service. He belonged to a Levitical lineage that was active in the post-Babylonian period.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the returning Levites
keyEvents.description: Jishua is mentioned among the Levitical families that returned from exile in Babylon to Judah.

keyEvents.title: Participation in temple service
keyEvents.description: Jishua and his descendants participated in restoring the temple service after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: The service of the Levites under Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Jishua is mentioned in connection with the organization and service of the Levites under Nehemiah's leadership in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Renewal of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Jishvah was among the Levites who participated in renewing the covenant with God during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Praise and Teaching for the People
keyEvents.description: Jishvah was among those who helped the people understand the Law when it was read aloud publicly.
